name: ai-task-list
title: AI Task List
description: A bordered panel headed Plan lists nested task rows with square checkboxes, and a count of finished steps sits at the top right. A green check draws in as each step completes while a moving underline marks the one still running.
use: An assistant runs a multi-step job and the user needs to see what is done, what is running and what comes next.
avoid: Finished rows drop to 65% opacity, so a long fully completed plan becomes faint to read.
a11y: Status lives only in colour and a drawn check, and the box SVG is aria-hidden, so a screen reader hears labels without pending, running or done. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded panel headed Plan with a small done count on the right, listing nested rows of a 14px square checkbox, a task label and an optional right-aligned note such as 3 jobs. Completed rows carry a green box and check and sit slightly dimmed.
behaves: As a step finishes its box fills and a green check draws in, the row dims and nudges down a pixel, and the header count rises. The active row carries a thin glowing underline sweeping left to right on a loop; with every step done nothing is running.
customise: Pass a tasks array of id, label, status, an optional note and one level of children; the heading label is a prop. Colours, check marks and timing need a source edit.
weight: light: A short list, one CSS-drawn checkmark and a single looping underline; idle once all steps finish.
